name: Knight Of The Realm
description: A decorated soldier with heavy armor and a powerful steed.

abilities.name: Chevalier
abilities.description: While the Knight is on a mount, they gain a +2 bonus to their Difficulty. When they take Severe damage, they’re knocked from their mount and lose this benefit until they’re next spotlighted.

abilities.name: Heavily Armored
abilities.description: When the Knight takes physical damage, reduce it by 3.

abilities.name: Cavalry Charge
abilities.description: If the Knight is mounted, move up to Far range and make a standard attack against a target. On a success, deal 2d8+4 physical damage and the target must mark a Stress.

abilities.name: For the Realm!
abilities.description: Mark a Stress to spotlight 1d4+1 allies. Attacks they make while spotlighted in this way deal half damage.
